title: DojoLiq Peach Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Vaporesso DojoLiq Peach Raspberry offers a wonderfully balanced fruit pairing that is both smooth and vibrant. The vape starts with the delicate, nectar-like sweetness of ripe Peach, delivering a soft and comforting base. This mellow profile is beautifully contrasted by a tangy burst of Raspberry on the exhale, adding a bright and slightly sharp fruitiness that completes the experience. To ensure peak performance, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid features a finely tuned 45% VG / 55% PG ratio specifically optimised for this blend. This bespoke formulation guarantees rapid wicking and maximum flavour transmission when used with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod systems and starter vape kits. The Nicotine Salt blend ensures a gentle throat feel and fast-acting nicotine relief. Brought to you by the hardware specialists at Vaporesso, the DojoLiq collection captures the vibrant, authentic flavours of their popular Dojo series in a versatile 10ml format. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, these e-liquids offer rapid nicotine satisfaction and consistently bold taste from the first drop to the last.
